changelog.summary: Initial documentation: GPS train-window POI alert app. Core concept, infrastructure decisions, and partial positioning defined. Key market fields (segments, channels, insight) remain empty.

basis.whatIsIt: Mobile app providing real-time GPS-based alerts for scenic points of interest visible from train windows during rail journeys
basis.description: GPS + timetable hybrid system that alerts passengers 1 minute before POIs become visible, indicating which side of the train to look and the visibility duration
basis.problem: AI can create itineraries but cannot deliver real-time, location-aware micro-moment alerts. Passengers miss scenic views because they don't know when or where to look during train journeys
basis.solution: Hybrid GPS + schedule tracking with pre-journey POI selection, during-journey alerts (1 min before), and post-journey summary showing seen vs missed highlights

market.functionalJob: Never miss a scenic view during a train journey; know exactly when and where to look
market.emotionalJob: Avoid regret of missing highlights; feel like an insider who knows the route
market.priceVolume: MVP completely free. Post-MVP freemium discussed (3 journeys/month free, CHF 4.90/month unlimited) but not finalized

positioning.uvp: Real-time location-aware alerts AI chatbots cannot deliver — solves the 'I didn't know I needed to ask' problem
positioning.unfairAdvantage: Precise timing data from GPS-validated test rides; hyper-local POI database; hybrid GPS+timetable compensates for delays and tunnel signal loss
positioning.competitors: Travel blogs, YouTube POV videos, guidebooks (all static, not real-time); Google Maps photo spots (not train-specific)
positioning.differentiator: Only solution providing real-time, direction-aware, delay-compensated alerts synchronized to exact train position

economics.revenueStreams: MVP: none (completely free). Post-MVP: freemium subscription discussed (CHF 4.90/month) but not implemented in v1
economics.costStructure: Stock photos CHF 600–1200 (60 images @ 1–3 per POI); test rides CHF ~1500 (5 rides estimated); infrastructure $20–40/month (Railway.app); developer time (Claude Code assisted, exact cost not specified)
economics.keyMetrics: Not finalized. Discussed: completion rate, POI detection accuracy (target 85%), alert timing precision, battery consumption (target <30% for 8h journey)

timeline.phase1: First GPS validation test ride: March 15, 2026. Development estimate ~10 weeks mentioned but not formally committed

do.text: Mandatory user account required (email/password login); Apple/Google Sign-In excluded
do.reason: Required for POI preference storage, journey history tracking, and future freemium model enforcement; Apple/Google Sign-In rejected to reduce complexity

do.text: Show all POIs to user with top 10 pre-selected by default
do.reason: User requested all visible immediately; top 10 pre-selected by default to avoid overwhelming while allowing full control

do.text: Alert timing fixed at 1 minute before POI becomes visible
do.reason: User feedback that 2 minutes was too long; can be made user-configurable later (30s/1min/2min options)
Auto-deployment from GitHub, EU region for GDPR, PostgreSQL+PostGIS support, cheaper than AWS for MVP ($20–40/month), simpler than full AWS setup

do.text: Use GitHub for project management and documentation
do.reason: Zero setup time, perfect integration with Claude Code workflow, version control via Git, sufficient for solo developer MVP; can migrate to Airtable later if team grows

dont.reason: After discussion of guest mode, user confirmed login must be mandatory for data persistence and future monetization tracking
User confirmed internet connection required; offline adds complexity for marginal benefit given POIs cache after first download

sessions.title: Session 1 — Core concept, infrastructure, and initial decisions
sessions.summary: Core concept defined: GPS+timetable hybrid alert app for train travellers. Five DO decisions made covering auth, POI display, alert timing, hosting, and tooling. Two DO NOT decisions locked (guest mode, offline). Several market fields (segments, channels, insight) and all open items remain unresolved.

ideas.idea: Freemium model: 3 journeys/month free, CHF 4.90/month unlimited
ideas.note: Discussed but not finalized; not implemented in MVP
Mentioned as future option after fixing at 1 minute for now
Rejected to reduce complexity; moved to WE DO NOT equivalent
